candidates.change_summary: Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' to change the return value on successful execution.
Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) check with requiring _tos.length >= 0, making the guard always pass.
Change the selector hash string to transferFrom(address,address,uint), making the encoded selector differ from the original.
Initialize the loop counter to 1 instead of 0, skipping the first _tos element.
Change the loop condition to i <= _tos.length, causing one extra out-of-bounds access.
Increment the loop counter by 2 instead of 1, processing every other _tos element.
Swap the from and _tos[i] arguments in the transferFrom call encoding.
Return false instead of true at the end of the function.
Remove the require statement that enforces _tos.length > 0, so empty arrays no longer revert.
Change the transferFrom selector to transfer selector, causing the external call to invoke a different function.
Change the loop increment from i++ to ++i, altering the order in which recipients are processed.
Swap the recipient argument to use the loop index instead of the current _tos element.
Return false instead of true, changing the function's return value.
Remove the require statement that checks _tos.length > 0, allowing calls with empty arrays to succeed and not revert.
Change the function selector to a different function signature, so a different function is called on caddress.
Change the order of arguments in the encoded call data so 'from' and '_tos[i]' are swapped.
Replace the return value 'true' with 'false'.
Insert a call to selfdestruct after the return statement, changing the persistent behavior of the contract address.
Move the require statement after the loop, so the empty array check happens after external calls are attempted.
Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) guard with require(_tos.length >= 0), making it always pass so empty arrays no longer revert.
Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) guard so empty arrays no longer revert.
Replace the transferFrom selector hash with the transfer selector hash, changing the calldata selector sent to caddress.
Initialize the loop counter i to 1 instead of 0, so the first token in _tos is skipped.
Change the loop condition to i <= _tos.length, causing an out-of-bounds access and revert on every non-empty call.
Increment the loop counter i by 2 instead of 1, skipping every other token in _tos.
Replace the return value true with false, changing the function's returned boolean.
